text:
Priya: Heads-up — AcmeHealth asked for a lightweight inference guidance feature that surfaces batching / caching / quantization suggestions per-route, plus eval-triggered regression alerts. Need to nail scope we can ship in 2 sprints. @Sam can you call out ops constraints?

Sam: Quick q — per-route recommendations only or global model profiles too?

Priya: Per-route is preferred (maps to Console routes). MVP: per-route heuristics + in-console actionable suggestions. Avoid heavy telemetry ingestion for v1.

Elena: Launch criteria proposal: 1) baseline heuristics for batch size & KV caching enabled; 2) quantization recommendation flow (recommend-only, no auto-apply); 3) eval-alerts wire-up for 1 pilot customer; 4) UX mock + basic docs. Also define SLO impact budget. :white_check_mark:

John: Acceptance checklist idea (e2e):
- suggestions surface for >= 90% of sampled routes
- p99 latency delta < 10% when suggestions enabled
- eval-alert FP rate < 5% on pilot signals
- rollback knob and audit logs exist

John: quick config sketch:```yaml
route_recommendations:
  enabled: true
  heuristics:
    batch_hint: "auto"
    cache_prefix: true
    quant_policy: "recommend-only"
eval_alerts:
  enabled: true
  threshold: 0.05
  pilot_customers: ["acmehealth"]
```

Priya: +1 to recommend-only for quant. We need to avoid auto-apply for safety. @Elena can you surface small UX flows: "Apply suggestion" vs "Preview only"? :thumbsup:

Sam: Ops asks: logs for experiments, safe rollback hook (feature flag per-route), and a small metric sink for eval-alert telemetry. Also need a plan if batch suggestions increase token cost.

ops-bot: created runbook ticket #5272 — https://redwood/internal/issue/5272 — added owners Sam/John. :spiral_calendar:

Elena: I'll mock the two-action UX (Preview / Apply) and a compact tooltip explaining latency vs cost tradeoffs. Sharing draft by EOD Thursday.

Priya: Any legal or data concerns? We should confirm no PII leaves customer env.

John: No PII expected; logs should be aggregated and sampled. Add opt-out flag at route-level.

Sam: Rough engineering estimate: 2 devs x 2 sprints for recommendation plumbing + 1 infra for eval-alert integration (can be parallel). Will refine after spike.

Priya: Sounds good. I'll capture as a roadmap slice: "Inference Efficiency Kit — per-route recommendations + pilot eval-alerts (recommend-only quant)" and assign owners. Will follow up with a short PRD. Thanks all. :rocket:
